Wine-house exterior, tea, entertainment. Specific programme order fictional.
Tea sellers, workers, fire watch and source reflection.

food_rules: No modern Sichuan chilli dishes; only broadly sourced noodle/meat/fish categories.
Warm-season episode: winter list appears only as a labelled contrast, never a simultaneous summer stall inventory.
Summer liquorice iced drink is a named offering, not an exact recipe or universal habit.

lighting_rules: Night sky dark, exposure concentrated around actual lamps/candles.
No lantern repeated in every image or modern-festival red lantern canopy.
No precise reconstructed lamp design close-up unless independently referenced.
Dawn scenes retain same street and become progressively lighter; no abrupt noon sun.

visual_reference_review.limitation: These are details from the Northern Song painting, not proof of exact night illumination; institutional caption cross-checked against Palace Museum original object.

performance_rules: Original illustrative storyteller; no invented speech presented as a quote.
Shadow theatre schematic only; no claim of exact surviving Kaifeng puppet forms.
No Qing opera masks, microphones, modern theatrical lighting or tickets with invented prices.
acceptance: Visitor's private outfit remains identical across every used pose and thumbnail.
No generic national costume or ethnicity change.
Restaurant serves plausible bowls with coherent hands; do not literalise the memoir's astonishing twenty-bowl description.
Source phrases and place names are local text, never image-model lettering.
84 shots are deliberate; no filler scenes needed solely to reach96. Narration pacing must still meet the actual10-minute minimum.
